name: Spellspurned (CR +2)
body:
For some reason or another, some creatures become disconnected from forces of the universe such that their bodies and minds simply reject all forms of magic.

Permanently disjoined from the makeup of arcana, these spellspurned creatures are nonetheless capable of thriving and operating even in the void of the supernatural. Many of the more scholarly spellspurned learn to utilize technology, supplanting the arcane arts with scientific wonders. In the rare event that they come into contact with magic-users, the rift between the two cultures is blatantly apparent, especially given their differing views on warfare, civilization, and especially the importance of the gods. As a result, spellspurned frequently destroy or are destroyed by their arcane counterparts.

Spellspurned is an acquired or inherited template that can be applied to any corporeal creature. In certain settings, spellspurned may exist which may only be severed from specific types of magic (such as arcane, divine, psionic, or akashic), in which case their abilities only affect magic of that type. A spellspurned creature uses the statistics of the base creature, except as follows.

Challenge Rating: Same as the base creature +2, or +1 if the creature is normally reliant upon supernatural abilities or spells.

Aura: Spellspruned creatures gain the following aura:

Arcane Interference (Su)

A spellspurned creature may projects an aura out to 10 feet which inhibits magic. Any creatures which enter the aura or start their turn in the aura have a 5% chance per Hit Die of the spellspurned to be subjected to an antimagic field until they leave the aura (roll separately for each creature). A spellspurned creature’s eldritch severance ability is not affected by this aura.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma.

Defensive Abilities: Spellspurned creatures reject any form of magic that would attempt to interact with their body or mind. They are treated as having unbeatable spell resistance.

Weaknesses: Spellspurned creatures gain the following weakness: Magic Rejection Spellspurned creatures lose all capacity to use magic in any form. They cannot cast spells or succeed at Use Magic Device checks. In addition, they lose all supernatural abilities (excluding those gained from this template).

Special Attacks: A spellspurned creature gains the following special attacks:

Eldritch Severance (Su)

A spellspurned creatures gains a melee touch attack that deals no damage but immediately subjects anything they touch to a targeted greater dispel magic effect with a caster level equal to the spellspurned creature’s HD. If an item rather than a creature is targeted (or if the spellspurned attempts to touch a magic item for any reason), the item loses all magical abilities for so long as the spellspurned touches it and for 1d4 minutes thereafter. If the spellspurned creature possesses at least 15 HD, this ability improves from affecting creatures with greater dispel magic to and suppressing the effects of items to affecting them with mage’s disjunction. The caster level check and save DC for these abilities are Charisma-based.
